title: Runtime checks
label: Runtime checks
checked: Extension loading and execution under the PHP CLI and PHP-FPM, API compatibility with the latest release, and the peak resident set size of a selective streaming scan.
description: tests/deployment.php checks the extension version, a group_by result, and the thread pool size; scripts/check-fpm runs it in a php-fpm worker through FastCGI. scripts/api-compat.php checks the latest release tag's stubs against the extension. tests/memory.php runs two streaming filters of a generated CSV in separate processes and compares their peak resident set sizes. scripts/check runs the CLI, API, and memory checks before a release, on Ubuntu 24.04 and macOS 15 with PHP 8.3, 8.4, and 8.5 in CI; the packaging workflow runs the PHP-FPM check in the production container.

comparison.applies_to: Each check; exit status of its script

cases.name: PHP CLI
cases.quantity: version matches Cargo.toml, a group_by result, and the thread pool size

cases.name: PHP-FPM
cases.quantity: the same assertions through a FastCGI request to a php-fpm worker
cases.reason: php-fpm or cgi-fcgi is not installed on the machine that made this record; CI runs this check in the packaging workflow.

cases.name: API compatibility with v0.2.1
cases.quantity: 948 functions and methods of v0.2.1 still exist, with its parameters as a prefix of today's

cases.name: Streaming filter memory
cases.quantity: peak RSS added by a streaming filter that keeps 4% of a 93 MB CSV: 31 MB, against a limit of half the file
